description: SPACEX CARGO RESUPPLY SHIP DEPARTS SPACE STATION FOR HOME  Loaded with scientific experiments and supplies, the unpiloted SpaceX Cargo Dragon undocked from the International Space Station September 30, completing a month-long mission to the outpost for the company’s 23rd commercial resupply services mission for NASA.
